drafter.private_reasoning: The draft lacks a payment amount, deadline, and payment mechanics. The release and confidentiality provisions also need workable limits. Remove the internal document properties before circulation and do not disclose the client's confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel, attached is our revised draft. We have clarified that the release takes effect upon receipt of payment and added customary exceptions to confidentiality. The settlement amount and payment details remain to be agreed. Please send your comments and proposed figures.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties in writing, by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff, within ten business days after both parties sign this Agreement. The parties will insert the agreed amount before execution.

2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the payment required by Section 1, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute resolved by this Agreement, whether known or unknown, through the date of execution. This release does not waive any right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are informed of its confidential nature; disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a legally required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party advance notice.
